newsitem.title: USA: GE Capital invests $2 mln in LaserMaster.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital invests $2 mln in LaserMaster.

text.p: LaserMaster Technologies Inc said Thursday it has signed a private placement agreement with General Electric Capital Corp, a unit of General Electric Corp.

The agreement provides for the purchase of up to $2 million of LaserMaster's common stock at market rates as of close on September 24, 1996, together with warrants to buy an equivalent number of shares in the future.
Since January 1996, GE Capital has provided LaserMaster with a $10 million revolving credit facility which is secured by receivables, inventory and other assets.
LaserMaster said it has been financing certain fixed assets with GE Capital under another financing agreement for several years.

In an unrelated transaction, LaserMaster said it agreed with one of its largest trade creditors, Marubeni International Electronics, to convert about $2.5 million in trade debt into a convertible subordinated debenture.

The agreement allows Marubeni to convert the debentures into common stock over a period of time. Marubeni will continue to supply product to LaserMaster and has agreed to grant favorable credit and payment terms on future orders. Marubeni and its supplier of components have also agreed to give the company about $1.5 million in free product to satisfy a warranty claim stretching back over two years.
LaserMaster designs, makes and markets fast, large-format color printers.
